description.value: RV-only park on the Trans-Canada highway east of Kamloops, directly beside BC Wildlife Park with guest discount admission; full-hookup sites cater to self-contained rigs, and no tent rate is listed, making it a marginal option for cycle tourers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone, address, URL). The park explicitly states it offers 'full hook up sites for self-contained RVs' with no mention of tent camping or hiker/biker sites, raising questions about suitability for touring cyclists. Nearby mountain biking trails and hiking are confirmed on the activities page, and reservations are clearly accepted via phone and email.
concerns: Park appears to be exclusively for self-contained RVs — website states 'We offer full hook up sites for self-contained RVs' with no mention of tent sites or hiker/biker accommodation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The park explicitly serves 'full hook up sites for self-contained RVs' only; there is no evidence of tent camping or non-RV accommodation, making suitability for touring cyclists unclear.

wow_evidence: full hook up sites for self-contained RVs; no tent camping mentioned
